name: ZPM
desc:
Special hullmod that can be installed only when ZPM is present in inventory. Installation removes all installed Asgard hullmods. 
Your fleet currently requires %s ZPMs to be operational, you have %s ZPMs in inventory.
If your number of ZPMs in inventory falls under %s, all ships loose equiped ZPM hullmods, connected boosts and will have to be re-equiped with ZPM hullmod again.

name: ZPM powered shields
desc: ZPM overcharges shield systems to increased durability, arc and unfold speed.

name: ZPM powered engines
desc: ZPM overcharges drive systems to increased speeds in hyperspace, star systems and battle.

name: ZPM powered beam weapons
desc: ZPM overcharges beam weapon systems to increased to increased damage, range and decreased flux cost.

name: ZPM flux system bypass
desc: ZPM supplements ship life support systems to decrease supply consumption and bypasses flux regulators to directly supply ship energy needs. However heat buildup requires ship to use flux system to store and vent massive ammounts of waste heat ZPM produces in shield and weapon systems.

Asgard sensors
sModDesc: Increases the ship's in-combat vision range by %s/%s/%s/%s, based on hull size.

name: Asgard computer core
desc: Extends the range of on-board weapons.
short: Increases weapon range, more so for larger ships.

name: Asgard shield
desc:
Reduces the amount of damage taken by shields by %s. Also extends the shield arc by %s degrees.
Shield modifications cause upkeep cost to increase by %s and unfolding speed to decrease by %s.

name: Asgard Hyperdrive
desc:
Increases maximum burn level by %s for frigates & destroyers, with an additional +1 for cruisers & capitals.
Restructure of the drive bubble reduces the impact of solar storms and other hazards by %s.
Hyperdrive emissions scale poorly with size, increasing cruiser & capital sensor profile by %s.

name: Asgard transporter
desc: Reduces the casualties suffered by fighter pilots by %s. Also lowers fighter refit time by %s, but uses up %s of the ship's flux capacity.
sModDesc: Increases the fighter pilot casualty reduction to %s.

name: Neutrino Ion reactor
desc: Neutrino Ion Reactor, a hull mod engineered for peak performance in the vast expanse of space. Lowers supply demands and fuel consumption by %s, thanks to the reactor's energy management systems. Augments the ship’s flux capacity by %s and enhances dissipation by %s. Interfacing of the reactor-flux modules increases vent speed by %s, but causes the ship to take %s more EMP damage. Equipment needed for the reactor both takes up %s of cargo space and results in %s slower ship repairs (in and out of combat).
short: A fragile reactor that reduces supply costs and increases flux stats.
sModDesc: Reduces maintenance cost, fuel use, and minimum crew requirement by a further %s.

name: Trinium alloys
desc: Increases the ship's armor by %s/%s/%s/%s points, depending on hull size. Also increases EMP resistance by %s, due to the alloy's composition.
short: Increases armor, maneuverability, and EMP resistance.

name: Auxiliary Naquadah generators
desc:
Increases peak operating time of this ship by %s seconds.
Also reduces the rate at which combat readiness degrades by %s.

Upon destruction of the ship, generators on board will go critical, increasing ship explosion power by %s.
short: Increases peak time, CR degrades more slowly.

name: Transportation rings
desc: Ring platforms are deployed using Asgard transporters to the surface of planets and space stations. Transportation rings deployment significantly enhances ground support capabilities up to %s marines, by enabling near-instantaneous transport of personnel, weapons, explosives, and medevac operations decrease causualities by %s percent. It increases the effectiveness of raids by providing a substantial bonus to ground support operations.
short: Gives bonuses to ground attack and reduces casualities.
